title: Strip the cipher prefix
brief: A spy intercepted coded messages where each line starts with a 3-letter station ID and a dash. Remove every prefix to reveal the plaintext.
text:
XQ7-Hide the gold
B2R-Meet at dawn
F91-Trust no one

expect.text:
Hide the gold
Meet at dawn
Trust no one

why: The substitute command with ^...- matches exactly three characters and a dash at the start of every line, stripping the station IDs in one pass.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use :%s to substitute across all lines.
